brandPositioningSummary: Moxy Hotels is a playful social lifestyle-select Marriott brand within Marriott International. For owners, the affiliation case is compact rooms, social public space, urban and lifestyle demand, operating implications, and Marriott Bonvoy distribution. It should be evaluated on its own guest promise and operating implications, not as a generic parent-brand substitute or an interchangeable peer among AC Hotels by Marriott, Aloft, Autograph Collection.
ownerFitSummary: compact rooms, social public space, urban and lifestyle demand, operating implications, and Marriott Bonvoy distribution
propertyFitSummary: urban lifestyle hotels and leisure-gateway sites that can activate social lobbies and accept compact guestrooms

scenarios.title: Urban social lifestyle conversion
scenarios.summary: An urban site where compact rooms and activated public space can create a social lifestyle offer. Moxy fits when owners accept room efficiency in exchange for lobby energy and Marriott Bonvoy reach. Owners should diligence whether Moxy Hotels is a better fit than AC Hotels by Marriott for the specific asset, capital plan, and operator capacity.

scenarios.title: Leisure-gateway lifestyle hotel
scenarios.summary: A leisure or mixed leisure-business gateway where younger and social travelers matter. Diligence should confirm F&B/bar intensity, noise management, and operating staffing for social spaces. Owners should diligence whether Moxy Hotels is a better fit than AC Hotels by Marriott for the specific asset, capital plan, and operator capacity.

scenarios.title: CALA lifestyle debut reference
scenarios.summary: Moxy Tulum provides a CALA open reference for owners comparing lifestyle-select Marriott affiliation in leisure destinations. Match by property name and keep the CALA label explicit.
